item.description:
What's new in ShawNotch 1.7.30

  • The Dock comes back when you switch Clean Desktop off, even after you went from music to a video while it was on.
  • Idle Curtain is now off until you switch it on, and it's part of Clean Desktop: you'll find it in Settings → Clean Desktop once Clean Desktop is on. It waits 10 minutes by default, and you can pick anything up to an hour.
  • Clock & Up Next shows only what's on your calendar today, in full, and shows nothing when your day is clear.
